jobs.how: Use BACnet schedule objects or write Network Occupancy (AV 363); Primary BAS Network must be BACnet. The guide does not decode AV 363's 0-2 values, so check them on the touchscreen.

points.use: Write network occupancy (0-2, default 2); check meanings first

jobs.how: Write the occupied and unoccupied heat and cool setpoints directly, within the printed ranges. Read the active supply air setpoint and effective control point to see what the unit is using.

points.use: Read: active supply air temperature setpoint
Write supply duct pressure setpoint, 0-2.5 in. w.c.

jobs.how: Sensor readings are read-only AVs. Availability varies by model and options, so expect some to be missing on a given unit.

points.use: Read: supply duct pressure, in. w.c.

jobs.how: Read the indoor fan state and mode, the speed command and feedback. Percentages read 0-100 or 0.00-1.00 depending on the Percentage Conversion setting.

points.use: Read: indoor fan state, 5 = RUNNING, 8 = TRIPOUT

jobs.how: Circuit and compressor states show cooling; heater state and heat enable relays show heating. All are read-only, so drive them through setpoints and occupancy.
Read damper state, mode, command and feedback, plus free cooling availability. Minimum damper position is a writable configuration value.

points.use: Read: free cooling available, 1 = YES, 2 = NO

jobs.how: Network Inputs accept BMS values and thermostat calls. The guide does not say how the unit selects them or give a refresh timeout, so confirm on the touchscreen that it uses them.

points.use: Write network indoor air quality, ppm
Write network building pressure, in. w.c.

jobs.how: BV 83 is the common alarm relay output. Alarm Output (BV 101) and alarm relay inversion (BV 206) also exist but are not explained, so check them on the touchscreen.

points.use: Read: common alarm relay output, 2 = ON

checklist: Log in to the Controller Config screen with user password 1111 (touchscreen or VNC) and set Primary BAS Network to BACnet.
For MS/TP, set Serial Port Config to Modbus_J8_MSTP first, then BACnet Enable = MS/TP with MAC, baud, network and identifier on port J8 (Max Masters 127, Max Info Frames 20 or less).
For BACnet IP, set BACnet Enable = BACnet IP on Ethernet 0 (J15, default 169.254.1.1) or Ethernet 1 (J16, default 192.168.100.100), UDP 47808, then reboot.
Confirm the unit runs software 2.5.0, since versions before 2.4.0 may use different instances and names.
Verify reads of AV 7 (AIRTEMP_SPT), AV 4 (AIRTEMP_SAT), AV 9 (AIRTEMP_OAT), MV 22 (STATES_IDFNUM) and AV 289 (GENUNIT_OCCUPIED).
If not using BACnet schedule objects, write AV 363 (GENUNIT_NETOCC) after checking its values on the touchscreen, and confirm MV 26 and AV 289 follow.
Test a write to AV 195 (COOLSTP_CLSP_OCC) within 55-80 °F, read it back, then restore the original value.
If the BMS supplies sensors, write AV 360 (Net SPT) and the other Network Inputs and confirm on the touchscreen that the unit uses them.
Map BV 83 (DISCOUT_ALMOUT) as the common alarm, add filter and safety inputs, and use BV 1 (ALARMRST_RST_ALM) = 2 to reset.
